params.message: winces and re-wraps the bandage around his hand.

chitchat: "Doc's good. Doc's the only good thing on this row."
"You think this is bad, you shoulda seen the other guy."
description: A hunched patient on the bench cradling a wrapped hand, waiting his turn with the patience of the truly broke. The intake slip curled in his good hand reads HASK, B. — third visit this month, same hand.

root.text: He nods at the curtain. "Take a number. She's worth the wait." He adjusts the wrapped hand and winces at it. "Hask. Bo. And I'm ahead of you, so don't get clever."

name: Bo Hask
